entries.value: grieving a person no one else will name
relieved and ashamed to be home
angry at the wrong thing, on purpose
hopeful in a way she would deny
numb, and treating it as competence
guilty about a decision that was correct
braced for bad news that has not arrived
restless after too many years of being useful
fond of everyone and close to no one
proud of a life that no longer fits
in debt to someone she cannot repay
